g.text: Every read is gated before it is used: too long for the amplicon, or noisier on average than
one error in a hundred bases, and it is dropped.

g.text: Each read is aligned against the target, its paralogue and any contaminant at once, and goes to
whichever it matches best. A paralogue can be a target of its own (run_targets).

g.text: The error rate is not assumed from the quality scores: it is measured in the AID-null libraries,
per position, substitution, strand and quality, then inflated by one factor fitted by leaving

g.text: Supporting reads are ranked by quality and every depth of evidence is tested against that
measured rate; the best test is kept and corrected for having tried them all. A change carried
by half the reads is germline, not a mutation.

g.text: Threshold set by the controls themselves
Each control is called against the other controls, giving decoy p-values. The p-value threshold
is the largest at which the false calls the decoys predict are at most 5% of the calls kept.

per animal, so clones of one lineage cannot stand in for independent mice.
